transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I've been noticing some things. I work as a financial advisor, and for a while now, I've been pretty certain that some people—mostly in the local arts and finance circles here in Cincinnati—are keeping tabs on me. Like, they're tracking which clients I meet with. 

I don't know, it's just... they send these little signals. Through event invitations, or the topics they bring up on panels, or even just who happens to sit near me at networking things. Sometimes I try to tell myself it's just a coincidence, but... I can't really let it go. It's just too specific.
Do you think there is any chance that these people are not actually sending you signals?
I mean... I guess there's a chance. Sometimes I tell myself that. That maybe it's just a coincidence. But... I don't know. I just can't really let it go. It feels too real to just be nothing.
How certain are you that these people are deliberately sending you these signals?

I'm... pretty convinced. Like I was saying, it's just... the way they track my clients. The specific panel topics they use to send those signals. I try to tell myself it's nothing, but... yeah. I'm pretty certain.
Have you ever heard or seen things that other people around you could not?
No. I haven't. Just... the things I already mentioned.
How long have you been having these thoughts that people are sending you signals?
Um... maybe about two months. That's when I first started noticing them tracking my client meetings... and doing the signals.
Before these last two months, have you generally been suspicious or felt that other people might be trying to use, harm, or keep tabs on you?
No... not really. I never really felt like that before. Just recently.
In the past two months, have you also had a period of feeling unusually depressed, or unusually high or energized, for several days or longer?
No... I don't think so. I haven't felt depressed or... unusually energized. Just regular, I guess.
Have you used any recreational drugs or stimulant medications recently?
No... I don't use anything like that. Just... coffee, sometimes. But no drugs.
Have these beliefs about people sending you signals been going on for at least one month?
Yeah... longer than a month. Probably... closer to two months, I think. That's just when I started noticing them tracking my client meetings... and sending the signals.
Has this been affecting your work or daily functioning?

I mean... I'm still working. It's just... maybe my practice has gotten a bit smaller lately. I guess I've missed a few follow-ups... and I try to avoid public panels now. It's just been a little harder to keep up the same level of client contact I used to manage. But I still work.
Have these beliefs been present for six months or longer?

Yeah... longer than six months. I guess... these changes have just kind of been building for a while now. Probably since... well, I got this recognition from an arts nonprofit. That was a little over two years ago. So, yeah. It's been a while.
